ewenloy_starkflow.name: StarkFlow
ewenloy_starkflow.description: Simple multiplayer: rooms, events and shared room state with atomic add.

server-url.name: Server URL
server-url.desc: WebSocket address of your StarkFlow server, for example ws://localhost:8080/ws

app-id.name: App ID
app-id.desc: Name of your game on the server. Rooms of different app ids never mix.

log-level.name: Log level
log-level.desc: What the plugin writes to the browser console.

auto-reconnect.name: Auto reconnect
auto-reconnect.desc: Reconnect and rejoin the room automatically after a connection loss.

replay-players.name: Replay players on join
replay-players.desc: After you enter a room, fire "On player joined" for every player already in it (including you), so one event can create all player objects.

send-rate.name: Send rate
send-rate.desc: How often synced objects and player properties are sent. Can be changed in the game with the Send rate actions.

connection-mode.name: Connection mode
connection-mode.desc: Auto (default) decides by the Server URL: ws:// connects to the game server directly, http(s):// means it is a cluster directory. Force one of the two if your URL cannot tell.

on-connected.description: Triggered when the server accepted the connection (also after an automatic reconnect).

on-disconnected.description: Triggered when the connection is closed for good.

on-reconnecting.description: Triggered each time the plugin schedules a reconnect attempt.

is-connected.description: True while connected to the server.

on-joined-room.description: Triggered when you entered a room (also after a rejoin; see Resumed).

on-left-room.description: Triggered after you left a room.

on-room-list.description: Triggered when the room list arrived.

is-in-room.description: True while you are in a room.

is-host.description: True if you are the host (the oldest active player) of the room.

on-player-joined.description: Triggered when another player entered the room. Read LastPlayerId.

on-player-left.description: Triggered when a player left for good. Read LastPlayerId.

on-player-suspended.description: Triggered when a player lost the connection. The place is kept for a while. Read LastPlayerId.

on-player-resumed.description: Triggered when a player with a lost connection came back. Read LastPlayerId.

on-host-changed.description: Triggered when another player became the host. Read HostId.

on-player-prop-changed.description: Triggered when a player property changed. Read LastPlayerId.

on-event.description: Triggered when an event with this code arrived. Read EventData and EventFrom.

on-any-event.description: Triggered for every event that arrived.

on-state-changed.description: Triggered when this state key changed.

is-syncing.description: True after "Start auto-sync" while auto-sync is running.

for-each-object.description: Runs the following actions once for every synced object: mine and the ones created for other players. Empty tag = all of them. Pick the instance with EntityUID, read the owner with EntityOwner.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Tag from "Register object for sync". Empty = all objects.

on-other-object-created.description: A remote player's object was materialized locally. Use ProxyUID with "Pick by unique ID". Global (host) objects fire "On entity created" instead.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Tag from "Register object for sync". Empty = any tag.

on-other-object-destroyed.description: A remote player's object is about to be destroyed (the player left or removed it). Global (host) objects fire "On entity destroyed" instead.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Tag from "Register object for sync". Empty = any tag.

on-entity-created.description: A synced global entity appeared (created by the host). Use EntityUID with "Pick by unique ID" to pick the instance.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Tag of a Global state object from "Register object for sync". Empty = any tag.

on-entity-destroyed.description: A synced global entity was removed. The instance is destroyed right after this trigger.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Tag of a Global state object from "Register object for sync". Empty = any tag.

on-rate-limited.description: Triggered when the server dropped a message because of the send rate limit (60 messages per second per connection). Send less often.

on-error.description: Triggered when the server sent an error. Read ErrorCode and ErrorMsg.

on-any-player-prop-changed.description: Triggered when any property of any player changed. Read LastPlayerId and ChangedPropKey.

for-each-player.description: Repeat the sub-events once for every player in the room. Read CurrentPlayerId inside.

connect.description: Connect to the server. Leave both empty to use the project properties and the saved token.

set-auth-token.description: Use a token you saved yourself (for example in the cloud save) at the next Connect.

set-name.description: Name sent to the server at the next Connect.

set-region.description: Clustered mode only. Forces the region ("eu", "ru", ...) instead of measuring the nearest one; pass an empty string to pick the nearest region automatically again.

region.name: Region
region.desc: Region name as reported by the nodes, or empty for the nearest one.

join-or-create.display-text: Join or create room [i]{0}[/i] (max players [i]{1}[/i], delete when empty after [i]{2}[/i] s)
join-or-create.description: Enter the room, create it if it does not exist. Max players 0 = server default. Delete time -1 = server default, 0 = at once.

join-room-password.description: Enter a locked room by id or by name. The password is kept for the automatic reconnect.

room.name: Room id or name
room.desc: Room id is exact; a name picks the oldest room with it.

join-or-create-password.display-text: Join or create room [i]{0}[/i] with password [i]{1}[/i] (max players [i]{2}[/i], delete when empty after [i]{3}[/i] s)
join-or-create-password.description: Enter the room with this password, creating it if it does not exist.

password.name: Password
password.desc: Password that will be required to enter.

request-rooms.description: Ask the server for the list of rooms.

send-event.description: Send an event to the room. Target: others, all, or a player id.

data.name: Data
data.desc: Text data (you build the format, for example x,y,angle).

to.name: To
to.desc: others, all or a player id.

set-state.description: Write a number or a text to the shared room state.

set-state-bool.description: Write a boolean to the shared room state.

add-state.description: Atomically add a number (can be negative) to a state key. The server applies it in order, so nothing is lost.

set-player-prop.description: Set a property of your player that everybody sees (ready flag, color...).

sync-object.display-text: Multiplayer: Register [b]{0}[/b] as [b]{1}[/b] in [b]{2}[/b] state (transform: [i]{3}[/i], interpolate: [i]{4}[/i], layer: [i]{5}[/i])
sync-object.description: Link an object type to multiplayer sync. Player state: each client owns its instance, others see proxies. Global state: only host simulates, everyone sees copies. Call before Start auto-sync. One tag = one object per player.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Sync tag, e.g. "player", "enemy", "ammo". Use "player" for the main avatar

scope.name: Scope
scope.desc: Player state = owned by each player. Global state = simulated by host only

interpolate.name: Interpolate transform
interpolate.desc: Smoothly interpolate synced transform fields between network ticks (position, angle, size, opacity). Visibility is never interpolated

layerName.name: Layer
layerName.desc: Layer for materialized instances. Empty = auto (layer of pre-placed instances, else bottom layer)

sync-object-variable.description: Add an instance variable of a registered object to multiplayer sync. Pick the variable from the dropdown - no typos, survives renames. Call after "Register object for sync" and before "Start auto-sync".

objectClass.name: Object
objectClass.desc: Object type already registered with "Register object for sync".

variable.name: Variable
variable.desc: Instance variable to synchronize (hp, ammo, score...).

interpolate.name: Interpolate variable
interpolate.desc: Smooth numeric changes between network ticks instead of jumping (numbers only).

bind-local-instance.description: Explicitly bind an instance as the local player's object for its registered player-scope tag. By default the first instance is bound automatically.

objectClass.name: Object
objectClass.desc: Object type registered in player state

start-sync.description: Apply schemas from registered objects and start automatic sync: local objects are sent, remote players' and host entities are created/updated/destroyed automatically. Call after "Register object for sync".

register-object.display-text: Sync [i]{0}[/i]: owner player [i]{1}[/i], slot [i]{2}[/i] | X [i]{3}[/i] Y [i]{4}[/i] Z [i]{5}[/i] angle [i]{6}[/i] size [i]{7}[/i] mirror [i]{8}[/i] animation [i]{9}[/i] frame [i]{10}[/i] visible [i]{11}[/i] opacity [i]{12}[/i]
register-object.description: Link the picked object(s) to a player. If the owner is you, the object is sent to the others; for any other owner it is moved by that player's data. Pick one instance (e.g. Player.pid = id); with several picked, slots go slot, slot+1, ... Use the same settings on every client.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The object to sync (pick instances before this action).

owner.name: Owner player id
owner.desc: Player id that controls this object, e.g. LastPlayerId or MyId.

slot.name: Slot
slot.desc: Number of this object among the owner's objects (0 for a single object). Must be the same on every client.

z.name: Z elevation
z.desc: Sync Z elevation (ignored in Construct versions that do not have it).

anim.name: Animation
anim.desc: Sync the animation name (Sprite only). Frames run by themselves on every client.

frame.name: Animation frame
frame.desc: Also sync the exact animation frame.

unregister-object.description: Stop syncing the picked object(s). Destroyed objects are removed automatically.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The object to stop syncing (pick instances first).

set-smoothing.display-text: Set smoothing of other players' objects to [i]{0}[/i] ms
set-smoothing.description: How long other players' objects take to glide to a new position. 0 = no smoothing (jumps). Default 70. Turning this on disables "Set smoothing (auto)".

set-auto-smoothing.display-text: Set smoothing (auto): follows the send interval
set-auto-smoothing.description: Like the smoothing checkbox in the server test client. On a server with the "sync" channel other players are drawn in the past by 2 x their send interval + the server batching window + 20 ms (80..300 ms); on an older server the time follows the send interval (1.4 x it, 70..300 ms). This is the default.

set-send-rate-preset.description: How often synced objects and player properties are sent: fast 58/s, medium 30/s, slow 15/s.

set-send-rate-custom.display-text: Set send rate to [i]{0}[/i] per second
set-send-rate-custom.description: Send at most this many times per second (1-60). Values above 58 are capped at 58, the server limit is 60 messages per second.

clear-rules.description: Forget all rules, strict mode and initial values set before.

set-strict.description: In strict mode the room accepts only keys that have a rule. Applies to rooms created after this action.

add-key-rule.display-text: Rule for state key [i]{0}[/i]: type [i]{1}[/i], mode [i]{2}[/i], min [i]{3}[/i], max [i]{4}[/i], max change [i]{5}[/i], reject [i]{6}[/i]
add-key-rule.description: Define what clients may do with a room state key. Applies to rooms created after this action (by Join or create).

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Who may change the value and how.

min.name: Min
min.desc: Smallest value, or empty for none (numbers only).

max.name: Max
max.desc: Largest value, or empty for none (numbers only).

max-delta.name: Max change
max-delta.desc: Largest allowed |change| of one Add. 0 = no limit.

reject.name: Reject
reject.desc: Reject out-of-range values instead of clamping them.

set-initial-value.description: Value the key has when a room is created by you. Works for constant keys too.

auth-token.description: Your signed token. Save it to keep the same identity on this device.

region.description: Clustered mode: the region you are connected to ("eu", "ru", ...), empty outside a cluster. Read it after "On joined room".

my-name.description: Your own nickname: what you set with "Set player name" (before joining) or the name the server confirmed (after joining).

ping.description: Round trip time to the server in milliseconds.

server-time.description: Server time in milliseconds (corrected for the clock offset).

status.description: disconnected, connecting, connected, in-room or reconnecting.

my-id.description: Your player id inside the room.

resumed.description: 1 if the last room join was a return to a room you were already in.

room-count.description: (Deprecated, use RoomListCount.) Number of rooms in the room list.

room-name-at.description: Name of the room at index.

room-players-at.description: Players in the room at index.

room-max-at.description: Max players of the room at index.

player-count.description: Number of players in the room.

player-id-at.description: Player id at index (sorted by id).

player-name-at.description: Nickname of the player at index (sorted by id). The same order as PlayerIdAt.

player-user-id.description: Permanent user id of a player.

player-prop.description: A property of a player (booleans are 1 or 0).

last-player-id.description: Player id from the last player trigger.

event-from.description: Player id that sent the last event.

state.description: Value of a state key (booleans are 1 or 0, missing = 0).

changed-key.description: Key of the last state change.

changed-value.description: New value of the last state change.

changed-old.description: Previous value of the last state change.

changed-by.description: Player id that made the last state change.

room-id-at.description: Id of the room at index. Pass it to Join room to enter exactly that room.

room-free-at.description: Free slots in the room at index; 0 means the room is full.

room-is-full-at.description: 1 if the room at index has no free slots.

room-locked-at.description: 1 if the room at index needs a password.

changed-prop-key.description: Name of the player property from the last "On any player property changed".

room-list-count.description: Number of rooms in the list loaded by "Request rooms".

room-player-count.description: Number of players in the room you are in.

room-max-players.description: Maximum number of players of the room you are in.

send-rate.description: Current send rate, flushes per second (1-58).

smoothing.description: The delay actually in use for other players' objects, in milliseconds: the interpolation delay on a server with the "sync" channel, the smoothing time on an older server.

synced-object-count.description: Number of objects registered for sync.

entity-uid.description: C3 UID of the current object (in "For each object" and its triggers). Use it with System "Pick by unique ID".

entity-owner.description: Player id that controls the current object (0 for objects the game never sent).

entity-type.description: Object type name of the current object.

entity-slot.description: Slot of the current object on its owner (technical, mostly for logs).

entity-field.description: Field of the current object: x, y, z, angle, width, height, size, mirror, animation, frame, visible, opacity, uid, tag, owner, slot, type. Example: StarkFlow.EntityField("x").

key.name: Field
key.desc: Field name, e.g. x, y, angle, animation.

entity-count.description: How many synced objects have this tag (empty tag = all).

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Tag from "Register object for sync". Empty = all objects.

local-entity-uid.description: C3 UID of my own object with this tag. Use it with System "Pick by unique ID" to make sure an event touches only my object.

player-proxy-uid.description: C3 UID of the object the plugin created for another player. Use it with System "Pick by unique ID".

proxy-player-id.description: Player id of the object in "On other player's object created/destroyed".

proxy-tag.description: Tag of the object in "On other player's object created/destroyed".

proxy-uid.description: C3 UID of the object in "On other player's object created/destroyed". Use it with System "Pick by unique ID".
